title: Speroplane's Items
description: A resource pack that retextures and renames a bunch of items to things that more resonate with speroplane's spirit.
body:
This pack changes some game items to things that
more closely resonate with Speroplane's squishy
little heart.

Here is a list of what this pack changes.



Texture, Name, and Model Changed

	All Swords------ (Material Type) Wand
	Baked Potato---- Dill Pickle Chips
	Bow------------- Stick Thrower
	Bread----------- Pizza
	*Carrot--------- Ice Cream
	Cooked Beef----- Borger
	Cooked Chicken-- Dino Nuggies
	Cooked Porkchop- Bacon
	Cookie---------- Pot Brownie
	Dried Kelp------ Spicy Almonds
	Flint and Steel- Lighter
	Golden Carrot--- B&J Ice Cream
	**Honey Bottle-- Iced Coffee
	Melon Slice----- Spironolactone
	Porkchop-------- Raw Bacon
	Pumpkin Pie----- Estradiol
	*Sweet Berries-- Wheat Thins

	* All plantable items will have their
	vanilla textures when planted. 
	
	**For items that convert to another item when 
	used, the converted item will have its vanilla 
	texture, returning an empty glass bottle 
	in the case of Iced Coffee.


Name Changed Only

	*All Axes--------- (Material Type) Chopper
	*All Hoes--------- Your Dad (Material Type) 
	*All Pickaxes----- (Material Type) Rock Knocker
	*All Shovels------ (Material Type) Spoon
	Poisonous Potato-- Xtian
	Trident----------- Sea Threek

	* The netherite version has had the model 
	and texture changed as well as the name.
